timeline.title: Install the zips
timeline.detail: On the Windows PC, run Install Forever.cmd from the iCloud test folder, then Ravenpost's exe from the Ravenpost folder. If the installer cannot find the _forever_ folder, write a note. Refresh any test zip that is behind its tag first.

timeline.title: Check that everything is green
timeline.detail: Every addon should be green, or amber for a reason you accept. The Forever build line should be unchanged and no card held. Anything red now gets fixed before midnight, not after.

timeline.title: Read the login screen
timeline.detail: Read the version line at the bottom left. 1.60.1 means our 16001 is right. If it says anything else, write a note: the patch wave carries the new number.

timeline.title: Open the AddOns list
timeline.detail: Click AddOns on the character screen. All nine should read as loadable (Out of date or Incompatible means the interface number is wrong, so write a note for that addon). While you are there, see whether character creation offers a Hardcore realm: if it does, Second Wind gets Forever work.

timeline.title: Turn on Lua errors and enter the world
timeline.detail: Type /console scriptErrors 1, make a Skyborne and enter the world in Zephras Isle. A Lua error at login breaks a check for the addon named in it.

timeline.title: Test each addon
timeline.detail: Take 30 to 60 minutes and go through the addons in order. Tick each check. For a broken one, write a note and add a screenshot if you can.

timeline.title: Turn on the Codex scan
timeline.detail: Turn it on with /codex and leave it on while you play. Its files feed the second Codex wave.

timeline.title: Morning: turn the notes into patches
timeline.detail: Copy the night's notes from this page, or run bun watchtower/server/control.ts notes. A session fixes each one, one patch per affected addon, and you give your go once for the whole wave. Also check two things on the web: upload a diary with Ravenpost and see that the character's gender appears in the site's profile (the French text reads it), and see that the Forever filter on CurseForge lists our addons.

timeline.title: Check the pins job at 04:17 UTC
timeline.detail: Check that the launch build reaches wow-data by itself. The Forever build line shows it.

timeline.title: Check the data jobs
timeline.detail: The launch build should have merged by itself and every addon's game data job should be green. If not, merge by hand with the wow-data-prs skill.
